## Outcome

W0 is complete: #40 -> PR #91 (internals) and #42 -> PR #90 (docs), both open against main and awaiting review. The run's substantive finding is a dispatch defect: divybot binds label -> agent but never a model, #40 declared no model: key, so the launch inherited claude-fable-5-1 from the host default and ran into a rate limit. The matrix was correct and non-binding at the same time. Host default is now claude-opus-5/medium, every /swarm block from here declares model and effort, and the Fable-blocked lanes fall back per the matrix's own token-limit column until midnight.
